current_repo_evidence.prior_lane_proofs: CRYPTO-DATA-01A (in-memory CSV-to-model-chain proof), CRYPTO-DATA-01B (DB persistence + readback proof), ASSET-CORE-04F (route-level ?registry_source=v2 valuation proof) already prove the local-CSV lane end-to-end at every layer except a recurring/operator-explicit scheduler wrapper, which this patch designs and the next patch should build.

notes: chosen_provider=none is deliberate: no live/network crypto data provider is implemented or verified anywhere in this repo today (see rejected_or_deferred_sources), and this patch is barred from making any network call to verify one. The chosen lane is local-file ingestion, not a provider.

requires_network_calls_in_next_patch=false and next_patch_network_calls_allowed=false both describe CRYPTO-DATA-01D as scoped by this design (a scheduler wrapper around the existing local-CSV ingest path) -- not a general claim that no future patch may ever make a network call.

canonical_symbols includes ETH/USD for consistency with ASSET-CORE-04E's original decision scope, even though no ETH/USD registry-v2 entry or CSV fixture exists yet (see current_repo_evidence.no_eth_usd_fixture_exists). Adding one is an optional, additive next-patch decision, not a requirement.

This artifact records a design decision only. No code in mqk-daemon, mqk-runtime, mqk-execution, mqk-broker-alpaca, mqk-broker-paper, mqk-risk, mqk-md provider implementations, mqk-portfolio, or any GUI/config/DB-migration/scheduler/provider-implementation file was changed by this patch.
